## Business summary
Music Japan LLC is an Osaka-based independent music company. It plans, produces and distributes artist releases, original songs and BGM, operates genre-focused music brands and accepts music licensing and collaboration inquiries.

## Core services
1. Artist release planning and music production
2. Original music and BGM production
3. Global music distribution
4. Music brand planning and operation
5. Music licensing and collaboration

## Artists and music brands
- Yuma
- Cozy Cafe Jazz BGM
- Relaxing Classical Music Live
- Deep Sleep Music Radio
